notes.title: Toilet Hero Version 0.0.6 Beta Update
notes.content:
Hi, heroes!

We’ve launched the version 0.0.6 beta update. This update fixes several important issues and optimizes the overall game experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680291/9fc09f1a82bbbee030ea41b5291c802be50debc0.png"]

🔧 Optimizations and Fixes:

Fixed the issue with the character selection box in the Dispatch Bureau.

Fixed the description error for the Frost Sorceress formation buff.

Fixed the card name display error in the Goddess’s followers interface.

Fixed the incorrect attack target for the Frost Tornado.

Fixed the size display issue for certain dragon enemies in the Frosttongue Library.

Optimized image loading to prevent a white flash screen during refresh.

Bolts and plungers no longer occupy inventory storage space.

Thank you all for your support and feedback! We will continue to optimize the game experience in future updates. Feel free to contact us through official channels if you encounter any problems. Happy gaming!

Toilet Hero Development Team

notes.title: Toilet Hero Version 0.0.5 Beta Update Log
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680291/c1ae548874904448f396ec8fc5cee317c3d99ab0.png"]

Hi, heroes!

We’ve released the 0.0.5 beta update, addressing several issues reported by players. Here’s what’s new in this update:

🔧 Optimizations and Fixes:

The Library achievement feature has been temporarily disabled, pending future activation.

An independent close button has been added to the Help interface for easier navigation.

Fixed the bug where players were immediately teleported back after dungeon teleportation. You can now reach your target area normally.

The double-speed combat setting now remembers your preference and won't reset every time.

Fixed an issue where the character data of Goddess’s followers didn’t sync properly during the upgrades in camps.

Fixed missing text in the descriptions of the Goddess’s followers.

Fixed the target errors of certain card effects.

Fixed display issues with character deck information in dispatch teams.

Thank you all for your feedback and support! We’ll keep on hard-working to make the path of the plunger smoother!

Toilet Hero Dev Team

notes.title: Version 0.0.4 Beta Update Log
notes.content:
Hi, warriors!



We've fixed some issues to make your plunge-tastic journey smoother! Version 0.0.4 Beta has been updated. Here’s what’s new:



🔧 Optimizations & Fixes:

Fixed Main Quest 5-5 Roadblock: No longer stuck in a literal logjam – flush your way to victory!

Drained Gear Stats Glitch: Equipment stats from toilet pulls won’t go rogue anymore.

Progress Bar Plunge Prevention: Main quest progress bars stay afloat when continuing your game. No more "down the drain" surprises!

Big thanks for your crap-tastic feedback! We’ll keep polishing this porcelain realm so you can plunge fearlessly.


Keep plunging forward! 💪🚽


The Toilet Hero Dev Team
